messages:
alex: evening handoff — quick summary from me. Quiet start, then we got a spike around 19:12 UTC where embedding p95 jumped and a couple customers reported degraded responses. Incident bot page came in for a partial KV cache eviction cascade.
sre-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: SEV2 - kv-cache eviction cascade - increased token latency p95 for embedding requests. link: https://infra.redwood/pagers/EVCT-778
mar ia: on it, i'm primary tonight. i started tracing and saw a flurry of evictions on pool-gpu-7 between 19:10-19:14. eviction_rate metric spiked from 0.2 -> 4.1/s.
jordan: saw the same in logs. small subset of requests caused large kv-key churn (prefix mismatch + long prompt prefixes). likely sticky to a customer experiment hitting long contexts.
samir: initial mitigation applied: increased kv cache size on pool-gpu-7 by +20% and disabled aggressive LRU compaction for 10m. command run: ```kubectl -n inference set env ds/kv-cache CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES=30720 && kubectl exec -it -n infra scaler-ctl -- patch --name pool-gpu-7 --cache-compact=false```
lee: rolled a soft throttle on embedding route for free-tier to shed 15% of burst traffic. config: `routes/embeddings.rate_limit: 850r/s`
alex: customer-impact: two enterprise customers reported elevated latency (10-15s p95) for embedding endpoints; no full outages. support notified and we've created a private ticket for both (SUP-1023, SUP-1024).
maria: runbook refs: https://confluence.redwood/internal/runbooks/kv-eviction and paste of quick steps in case next oncall needs them.
maria: short checklist i followed: 1) confirm eviction spike 2) identify offending pool 3) increase cache size / disable compaction 4) temporary route throttle / scale pool 5) open support ticket
jordan: scaling note — autoscaler didn't trigger because we hit eviction lock; manually bumped replica count on pool-gpu-7 from 4 -> 6. ```infractl scale pool-gpu-7 --replicas=6 --reason="eviction_spike"```
samir: after changes p95 dropped back gradually over 12m. metrics: p95 embeddings 19:10=6200ms, 19:22=420ms. eviction_rate back to ~0.3/s.
lee: left a quick rule change in ops console to add a temporary watch alert: `alert: kv_eviction_rate > 1 for 5m` -> notify oncall channel + ops-pager.
alex: coverage gap: early evening we had only one secondary online (maria primary, backup was transitioning). need explicit primary/secondary swap protocol — last time transition overlapped with a deploy. action: update runbook to call out thrash windows and hold deploys for 15m after handover.
maria: agreed. action items for next shift: 1) verify both primary/secondary are healthy before any infra deploys, 2) add a short pre-handoff checklist on the rotation bot.
jordan: noted. also we should add a test to CI to run a synthetic long-prefix embedding workload against new pools before routing traffic.
sre-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident EVCT-778 resolved 19:27 UTC. Mitigations: cache size increase, compaction disabled, manual scale + route throttle. No further pager triggers.
samir: postmortem timeline will go into postmortems/EVCT-778. i'll own the initial draft (ETA tomorrow 1700 UTC) and include customer impact window + runbook gaps.
lee: for follow-up - check billing and CPU pressure on pool-gpu-7 after cache bump, and ensure autoscaler config allows for eviction-induced scaleouts.
alex: next steps for oncoming shift (maria -> jordan handoff at 00:00 UTC): 
- jordan to confirm replica counts & cache settings for pool-gpu-*
- jordan to validate alert thresholds are active (kv_eviction_rate, embedding_p95)
- jordan to run quick synthetic test: ```python tools/smoke/emb_smoke.py --pool pool-gpu-7 --sequence 2048 --qps 50 --duration 60```
maria: i'll leave pinned logs and the exact commands i ran in #eng-oncall-files. also added troubleshooting notes under the runbook page.
jordan: will take over, i'll check infra health at 23:50 UTC. if anything flares, @alex i'm primary backup reachable by phone.
alex: thanks — summary status: incident mitigated, customers notified, manual fixes applied, runbook update + postmortem TODOs. no active pages. handing off to jordan at 00:00 UTC. :eyes:
